text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — after last night's flashv3 rollout into canary we saw tokens/sec drop ~12% for chat-5k workloads and cost $/M tokens up ~18% on average. Root cause unknown, filing here for triage.

Aj Patel: which models + batch configs? can you paste perf run ids?

Maria Chen: canary model=redwood-open-13b-quant, kernel=flashv3-hybrid, batch_policy=dynamic-prefix-aware, run=perf-1967890001. TL;DR: CPU side shows more kernel selection switches, CUDA kernels smaller and more frequent. KV hit rate dropped 6% for longer contexts.

Logan Rivera: looking at perf-1967890001 — trace shows frequent fallbacks from fused->paged at seq>1024. suspects: tiling threshold adjusted in flashv3. snippet:
```
[trace] kernel_select: fused (seq<=1024)
[trace] kernel_select: paged (seq>1024)
[trace] kv_cache: evict_ratio +0.05
```

Kelsey: Also saw increased small-batch invocations because dynamic batching heuristic started favoring latency SLOs; more 1-2 request batches which hurts throughput. maybe batching window changed.

Aj Patel: I repro'd locally with microbench: tokens/sec baseline 18.2k -> 16.0k. nvprof shows kernel launch overhead up +22%. Cost calc: tokens/sec drop => $/M tokens (gpu hour cost) increases. Quick calc in thread:
```
baseline: 18.2k t/s -> 3600*18.2k=65.5M tokens/hr
canary: 16.0k t/s -> 57.6M tokens/hr
delta = -7.9M => tokens/hr -12%
$/M baseline = $x -> canary = $x * 1.18 (approx)
```

perf-bot: perf-run perf-1967890001 completed. summary: tokens_per_sec: 16000, avg_latency: 240ms, kv_hit_rate: 0.87, kernel_switches: 4.1/s

Maria Chen: next steps: 1) pin kernel selection policy to previous thresholds and run A/B; 2) run microbench with forced fused-only; 3) capture full nvprof/metrics on canary (need SRE support). Anyone pick 1 or 2?

Logan Rivera: I'll run fused-only microbench and share results by EOD. Kelsey can you dump batching histograms for last 24h?

Kelsey: on it. grabbing histograms now — will post link.

SRE Bot: @here created incident/1967890 for regression triage. Pager escalated to eng-runtime if no ack in 30m.

Aj Patel: acked. I'll also instrument the kernel selector to log decision reasons (cache pressure, seq_length, cost_est).

Maria Chen: thanks. keep thread small — ping in eng-runtime channel for updates. :thumbsup:
